summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing the grant of 224,739 restricted share awards (equivalent to 1,123,695 underlying shares) under its 2019 Share Incentive Plan to eligible employees. The awards have a nil purchase price, vest in three installments on September 1, 2027, 2028, and 2029, and are subject to performance targets and clawback provisions. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special-situation event. The filing includes no M&A activity, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review. It is a standard administrative report on employee incentive grants, with no implications for corporate structure or control.
